title: Health Requirements and Contingency Plans for Singapore Hosting World Economic Forum in 2021
what_it_is: Health Requirements and Contingency Plans for Singapore Hosting World Economic Forum in 2021

sections.label: Public health measures for attendees
sections.summary: Attendees will follow public health requirements including testing and safe management measures, with contingency plans still being worked out.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Attendees will adhere to prevailing public health requirements and safe management measures.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: These include a rigorous testing regime, including pre-departure and on-arrival testing, as well as strict safe management measures during the Meeting itself.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: To minimise the risk of seeding local transmissions, we will also put in place measures to manage the interactions between the local community and the event attendees.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The specific public health requirements and contingency plans are currently being worked out and will take into consideration the latest COVID-19 situations here in Singapore and also globally.

sections.label: Introducing local companies to WEF
sections.summary: Local companies and service providers are being introduced to the WEF and its event organiser to explore potential partnerships.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: In addition, we have also been introducing interested local companies and local service providers to the WEF and their contracted event organiser, PublicisLive, to explore potential partnerships between our local companies and service providers as well as PublicistLive and the event organiser.

sections.label: Vaccination and segregation plans
sections.summary: No vaccination requirement for the public is stated; the situation will be evaluated and attendees segregated from the local population.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
sentences.text: But are there plans to require the majority of the Singapore public to be vaccinated before the event?

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: We all know that the availability and the roll-out of vaccines globally and, in fact, in Singapore are still being worked out, as the Co-Chairs of MTF had described yesterday.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: So, we will continue to evaluate the situation with these roll-out programmes locally as well as globally and apply the prevailing conditions to all incoming travellers to Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: And I have said earlier that we will make special plans also to ensure that event attendees as well as the local population are also being segregated as well for the safe conduct of the event.
